name: Rockstar Launcher Error 1002
commands:
$Key = "HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\User Shell Folders"

$Base = $env:USERPROFILE

Get-Process explorer -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 800

$folders = @(
    "Desktop",
    "Documents",
    "Downloads",
    "Favorites",
    "Music",
    "Pictures",
    "Videos",
    "Pictures\\Screenshots"
)

foreach ($folder in $folders) {
    $path = Join-Path $Base $folder
    if (-not (Test-Path $path -PathType Container)) {
        New-Item -Path $path -ItemType Directory -Force | Out-Null
    }
}

function Set-ExpandStringValue {
    param (
        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $Name,
        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $Value
    )
    Set-ItemProperty -Path $Key `
                     -Name $Name `
                     -Value $Value `
                     -Type ExpandString `
                     -Force `
                     -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null
}

$shellFolders = @{
    "Desktop"                                = "%USERPROFILE%\Desktop"
    "Personal"                               = "%USERPROFILE%\Documents"
    "My Pictures"                            = "%USERPROFILE%\Pictures"
    "My Music"                               = "%USERPROFILE%\Music"
    "My Video"                               = "%USERPROFILE%\Videos"
    "Favorites"                              = "%USERPROFILE%\Favorites"
    "{374DE290-123F-4565-9164-39C4925E467B}" = "%USERPROFILE%\Downloads"
    "{B7BEDE81-DF94-4682-A7D8-57A52620B86F}" = "%USERPROFILE%\Pictures\Screenshots"
    "{F42EE2D3-909F-4907-8871-4C22FC0BF756}" = "%USERPROFILE%\Documents"
    "{0DDD015D-B06C-45D5-8C4C-F59713854639}" = "%USERPROFILE%\Pictures"
}

foreach ($pair in $shellFolders.GetEnumerator()) {
    Set-ExpandStringValue -Name $pair.Key -Value $pair.Value
}

Write-Host "Starting explorer again..." -ForegroundColor Cyan

Start-Process explorer.exe

Write-Host ""

Write-Host "Registry changes applied." -ForegroundColor Green

Write-Host "For the changes to fully take effect you should:"

Write-Host "  • Log off and log back in"

Write-Host "  OR"

Write-Host "  • Restart the computer"

Write-Host ""

Write-Host "If nothing changes → check if OneDrive is syncing these folders or if a group policy is overriding them."
